about: Hand-made reaction video: one magic reveal that needs the signed card, then a boring segment.

segments.text: Okay, this video has been all over my feed.
A street magician and a really skeptical guy.
Let's see if he can fool him.
He shuffles the deck, pretty normal so far.
The guy picks a card and signs it.
Wait, pause, watch the magician's left hand.
Did you see that? He palmed something.
Okay, play it again, slow motion.
Yes! He had the signed card the whole time!
It was in his sleeve since the shuffle!
That is the cleanest sleight of hand I've ever seen.
Chat, did anyone else catch that?
Moving on, the next video is about cooking.
This guy is making a sandwich, I guess.
Yeah, it's a sandwich. Nothing happens.

good.why: signed card, the palm, the reveal

stub.title: He had the card all along
